name: repeatpost
description: Plan, write and schedule social media posts across your connected RepeatPost channels.

interface.longDescription:
RepeatPost is a social media scheduler. This plugin lets you plan, write and schedule posts to your social media channels from a chat. Ask in plain words, and ChatGPT works in your RepeatPost workspace: it schedules posts, writes captions in your brand voice, designs branded graphics and keeps your media library tidy. It works with the channels you have connected and stays within your workspace role.

What you can do:

- Posts: create a draft or schedule a post for later. List posts by date range, channel and status, or open a single post. Edit, reschedule or publish now. Delete a post from RepeatPost, or also from the platform if you are the workspace Owner.
- Channels: list your connected channels with their platform, name, status and character limit. Look up a platform's posting rules, such as limits, supported media and settings.
- Captions: write a caption in your brand voice.
- Branded graphics: ChatGPT designs the layout, and RepeatPost renders it as a PNG in your media library in square, portrait, story, landscape or wide sizes. No AI image model is involved. RepeatPost can also put your logo, a brand-colour frame or a caption band on a photo from your library, saved as a new copy.
- Media library: search your media and browse folders. Upload an image or video from a public link. Create folders, and rename, move, favourite or delete items.
- Brand voice: list your brand voices, see which one applies with its colours, logo and visual style, and change your default.
- Workspaces: list your workspaces and switch the one ChatGPT works in.

Supported platforms: Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, X (Twitter), Threads, Bluesky, Mastodon, YouTube, Pinterest, Dribbble, Google Business Profile, Telegram, Slack, Discord and WordPress.

You stay in control. You sign in to RepeatPost with OAuth and choose each permission on the consent screen, so you can give read-only access if you prefer. ChatGPT can never do more than your workspace role allows, and if a channel needs approval, posts scheduled there go to approval first.

A RepeatPost account is required. Learn more at https://help.repeatpost.com/integrations/mcp-server
